Nothing pushed or merged. Awaiting founder authorization.

Founder authorized closing the witness-read RLS gap first, then push+PR. Added migration 20260822191355_verification_witness_read_access.sql (one additive SELECT-only policy), qa-security re-confirmed PASS. Pushed feature/passport-verification-tiering to origin @ 65ab205 and opened PR #13 against main. main remains unmerged/untouched. Creative Projects foundation intentionally on hold until this PR merges.

Founder authorized final merge. Ran final release check (PR state, mergeability, CI checks, diff scope, RLS fix present, no unexpected commits, production migrations match branch, build/typecheck/lint/tests green) — all clean, no scope changes made. Merged PR #13 via standard merge commit b957b08. Switched to main, fetched/pulled, confirmed local main == origin/main == b957b08, working tree clean. Batch 14 (Passport verification-tiering) complete.

Founder authorized Batch 15: Creative Projects foundation (creative_projects + creative_project_members only; Studio Sessions/Contributions/creative_roles explicitly deferred). Verified local main == origin/main == b957b08, created feature/creative-projects-foundation off verified main. Delegating schema-auditor first, per explicit instruction, before any migration is proposed.
Ran a read-only recovery audit (git state, live-vs-local Supabase diff, full build/typecheck/lint/test suite — all green, no creative-projects code exists anywhere yet) before resuming design work.

Ran the Batch 15 schema/architecture design pass: schema-auditor (data model, ownership invariant, RLS matrix, indexes, precedent comparison against organization_members) and passport-reputation (independent verification-boundary review) in parallel, both read-only. Delivered full architecture report to founder. Verdict: NEEDS ARCHITECTURE DECISION on two product-posture questions (member self-leave permission; full-roster visibility for active members) — both are safe either way, no security gap in either direction.

Founder approved both posture questions: (1) active non-owner self-leave via direct DELETE RLS policy, owner can never self-leave; (2) full active-member roster visibility, scoped per-project. Delegated supabase-backend to write the single additive migration per an exact spec (schema, RLS matrix, owner-sync trigger, recursion-safe helper) mirroring organization_members/is_conversation_member precedent.

Delivered 20260823030558_creative_projects_foundation.sql and a hand-edited lib/database.types.ts update (not machine-regenerated — migration not applied live, so generate_typescript_types would read stale schema). No apply_migration/execute_sql call made against live Supabase. One documented, reasoned deviation from spec: omitted a Functions entry for sync_creative_project_owner_membership() since it's fully revoked from all roles, matching this file's real precedent (organization_members' equivalent sync trigger is likewise absent from Functions).

Verified migration and types diff directly, wrote tests/integration/creative-projects.rls.test.ts (STAGING_ONLY describe.todo/it.todo matrix, mirrors flow-sec-001/organization-location pattern — no app-layer code exists yet in this DB-only batch to justify a lib/authz.ts predicate). Ran npm run typecheck/lint/test/build independently — all green (136/136 tests, 0 lint errors, build succeeded).

Full reconciliation pass against all 10 founder requirements (additive-only, owner-sync invariant, self-leave, roster visibility/cross-project isolation, recursion safety, admin precedent, Passport/verification decoupling, scope boundary, indexes, types accuracy): 10/10 PASS, Go recommendation. One informational note: an admin-override owner-transfer gap on creative_projects mirrors an already-accepted, out-of-scope pattern in organizations/orgs_owner_manage — not a new regression, no fix required.

First independent QA/security pass: FAIL. Found creative_project_members_owner_manage's UPDATE policy didn't pin profile_id/project_id to pre-update values — a project owner could rewrite an existing non-owner row's profile_id to an arbitrary third-party profile and mark it 'active', forging a non-consensual membership with no invite ever happening, reachable directly via PostgREST since this batch has zero app-layer code. Routed back to supabase-backend; everything else (additive structure, self-leave, roster scoping, admin gating, Passport boundary, types accuracy, full build/typecheck/lint/test suite) passed cleanly.

Closed the gap with a column-level privilege restriction on the same unapplied migration file: revoke update on creative_project_members from authenticated; grant update (role, status, joined_at, invited_by, updated_at) to authenticated — profile_id/project_id excluded, so any UPDATE naming them now fails on privilege grounds (42501) before RLS is even evaluated. Judged no legitimate admin/owner use case needs in-place identity mutation (delete+insert is the correct pattern, preserves the audit trail). Updated the migration's own header comment to document it.
Re-ran npm run typecheck/lint/test/build after the fix — all green, no regressions.

Re-review: PASS. Confirmed the exact original attack now fails on privilege grounds regardless of RLS, confirmed the legitimate owner-manage use case (activate a member, adjust role/status/joined_at) still works, confirmed no other accepted non-blocking items regressed, independently re-ran the full verification suite (all green). Batch 15 round-1 build+QA complete.

Rejected the round-1 checkpoint on product/architecture grounds: hard-DELETE self-leave destroys history (must become status='removed'+removed_at via a narrow RPC instead), 2-value status enum insufficient (need suspended/removed), no proof owner_id can't drift via admin override, invited_by still client-forgeable, and role model (owner/member vs owner/admin/contributor) was silently chosen rather than deliberately decided. Required 28 TODO tests be backed by real database-backed execution, not described as passing coverage. Delegated a supabase-backend fix+harness task; it hit a session usage-limit error mid-task and was terminated after only rewriting the header comment (not the SQL), leaving the file self-contradictory.

Verified the actual executable SQL against all 7 specific mismatches the founder flagged — confirmed every one still present (2-value status check, no removed_at, no leave_creative_project(), no invited_by trigger, old self-leave DELETE policy still present, invited_by still in the UPDATE grant, no owner_id immutability fix) despite the header already describing the fixed design. Implemented all of it directly (deviation from normal delegation-only practice, due to the usage-limit constraint): removed_at column + consistency CHECK, expanded status enum, leave_creative_project(p_project_id) SECURITY DEFINER RPC (mirrors remove_connection's jsonb-result idiom), BEFORE INSERT invited_by-overwrite trigger, tightened owner_manage with-check and column grants, new column-level UPDATE restriction on creative_projects. Made and documented the 4 required architecture decisions (owner/member kept, owner_id kept, title kept, no project-status column) directly in the migration header.

Built and ran a real ephemeral Docker Postgres 16 RLS test harness (verified Docker/image-pull availability first): stub auth.uid()/auth.jwt(), real anon/authenticated roles, real is_flow_admin()/set_admin_updated_at()/log_admin_change() copied verbatim from the real migration, the exact final migration applied with zero SQL errors, fixtures across 2 projects and 7 personas, 41 real role-switched SQL assertions executed — 41/41 passed after fixing two harness output-capture bugs (prelude noise polluting exact-match comparisons; two of the harness's own expected-value typos). Container torn down; harness scripts + results log archived to the session scratchpad (not committed — ephemeral verification artifact) for independent re-run.

Rewrote tests/integration/creative-projects.rls.test.ts to match the new design and explicitly mark which of its 34 it.todo() entries now have real executed proof (via the harness) versus which remain spec-only pending a permanent staging project. Re-ran npm run typecheck/lint/test/build — all green.

Final static re-audit of the truly-final SQL against all 10 founder-specified attack categories (owner orphaning, self-escalation, fake membership, cross-project leakage, roster enumeration, status semantics, owner transfer, forged invited_by, column-privilege bypass, SECURITY DEFINER search_path safety): PASS/GO on all 10. Confirmed zero live drift (creative_projects/creative_project_members still absent from live Supabase). One non-blocking finding: the header comment's claim that no policy sets status='suspended' contradicted the file's own owner_manage with-check — flagged as a doc-accuracy fix, not a security issue.
Fixed the doc-accuracy issue schema-auditor found (comment-only change, no behavior change).

Final adversarial review: PASS. Independently re-ran the Docker harness from scratch in its own container (byte-identical migration file, fresh fixtures) — 41/41 confirmed. Ran additional adversarial probes: owner cannot self-suspend (profile_id<>self guard holds for the new suspended transition too), a suspended member cannot use leave_creative_project to jump straight to removed, concurrent leave_creative_project calls are race-safe under the FOR UPDATE lock (one succeeds, one correctly fails not_active, no deadlock/double-processing), the removed_at consistency CHECK constraint is airtight even against a superuser/RLS-bypassing direct write, and trigger-firing order is unambiguous (exactly one BEFORE INSERT trigger exists). Re-ran typecheck/lint/test/build independently — all green. No blockers found.
Approved the full release sequence: live apply, static gates, commit, push, PR — explicitly not merge (separate authorization required after CI + release-manager review).

Ran local pre-apply checks (working-tree scope, additive-only grep, executable-coupling grep, 8-element required-design-feature check) — all clean. Delegated supabase-backend for the live pre-apply gate + apply + post-apply verification + Phase-3 live definition comparison + Phase-4 types reconciliation.

Pre-apply gate passed (no drift, tables absent live). Applied the migration live. Every object verified byte-for-byte against the reviewed design via direct live queries (pg_policies, pg_proc/pg_get_functiondef, pg_trigger, pg_constraint, pg_indexes, information_schema.column_privileges) — all 8 RLS policies (3 on creative_projects, 5 on creative_project_members; self_leave policy correctly absent), all 4 functions (search_path fixed on all), all 6 triggers, all constraints/indexes, and both column-level grant restrictions matched exactly. generate_typescript_types diffed against the hand-written lib/database.types.ts: byte-identical shape (one cosmetic line-wrap difference only) — no file edit needed. Flagged one anomaly: apply_migration recorded the live version as its own apply-time timestamp (20260823041155) rather than reusing the file's 20260823030558 name.

Recognized the version/name mismatch as the exact migration-filename-drift class this repo has hit and fixed twice before (ecac280, 248f761). Renamed the local file to supabase/migrations/20260823041155_creative_projects_foundation.sql to match live exactly — pure rename, sha256 unchanged (ed899cce8a508c6633a692b595cfbd3a680940d2d92532b69a1454440c5630bd), no content/schema change. Updated the one stale filename reference in tests/integration/creative-projects.rls.test.ts. Re-ran npm run typecheck/lint/test/build — all green (136/136 tests, 0 lint errors, build succeeded, 57 routes — the earlier-reported '47 routes' baseline was a miscount from an imprecise grep pattern in an earlier turn, not a real prior count; this batch touches zero app/ files so the route count is unaffected by Batch 15 either way).
